data.long_meaning: From the Hebrew root 'yad' which means 'hand'. In Christian tradition, the name Yadira symbolizes God's guiding hand and protection. The name Yadira carries the meaning “God's hand” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Yadira usually hope their child will grow to embody god's hand and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes God's guiding hand and protection.
data.etymology: Yadira belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “God's hand.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Yadira total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

in_hebrew.name: יאדירא
in_hebrew.meaning: השם יאדירא נגזר משורש עברי ופירושו 'תודה' או 'הודיה'
in_hebrew.long_meaning: השם יאדירא מקורו בשורש עברי שפירושו 'תודה' או 'הודיה'. הוא קשור לערכים של הכרת תודה והערכה. לא קיים אזכור ישיר לשם זה בכתבי הקודש, אך הוא מייצג ערכים חשובים בתרבות היהודית והנוצרית.

in_greek.name: Γιαδίρα
in_greek.meaning: Το όνομα Γιαδίρα δεν έχει άμεση ελληνική ρίζα, αλλά πιθανόν συνδέεται με την ισπανική προέλευση
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Γιαδίρα δεν έχει άμεση ελληνική ρίζα. Πιθανόν συνδέεται με την ισπανική προέλευση και σημαίνει 'υπηρετώ' ή 'αφιερωμένο'. Στην παράδοση της Ανατολικής Ορθόδοξης Εκκλησίας, δεν υπάρχει συγκεκριμένη αναφορά στο όνομα αυτό, αλλά μπορεί να συσχετιστεί με έννοιες αφοσίωσης και υπηρεσίας.

in_latin.name: Yadira
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Yadira origine Hispanica, significat 'gratitudo' vel 'adscribere'. In traditione Christiana, nomen hoc reflectit valores gratitudinis et devotionis. in_english.name: Yadira

Though not directly mentioned in the Bible, it aligns with biblical principles of thanksgiving and worship. Historically, the name has been used in Christian communities to signify a spirit of praise and service. It carries spiritual significance for its association with positive virtues.

data.spiritual_significance: The name Yadira carries a deep spiritual significance as it represents God's guiding hand and protection. In the Bible, God is often referred to as the one who holds and supports us, just as a hand holds and supports an object. Yadira is a reminder that no matter what challenges we face in life, God is always present and ready to guide and support us.
